user_story:
As a user, I want to be able to view the items in my shopping cart so that I can proceed to checkout or continue shopping. 
Acceptance Criteria:
1. The shopping cart page should display the header with the text 'Your Cart' (element: [data-test="title"]).
2. The page should have a button to 'Continue Shopping' (element: [data-test="continue-shopping"]).
3. The page should have a button to 'Checkout' (element: [data-test="checkout"]).
